service.description: getMarketingPublication: the lists the site's Marketing mount offers (or the one named by contactListId), each with its name, description, channel and the consent wording its offer shows; the organization's name. A site without the mount, a list it does not offer (no public offer on this site, the interval not open, archived, a mailbox, another organization's) and a site offering none answer the same NotFound.

requestSubscription: emailAddress, displayName (optional), contactListIds (each offered on this site, at most ten), consent (the box ticked) and operationId (PASS's request key). The address's directory party or a new person is filed pending on each list through the audience's evidenced path (one public request, an expiring confirmation) and a rate-limited verification message is queued on the ledger from a ready transactional sending profile of the organization with the confirmation template the list's policy names, and attempted once the request commits (never inside it). Answers the same receipt whatever happened (a new or a matched party, a member already, a refusal, a repeat of the key, a limit reached). Refuses VALUE_INVALID (the address, the name, no topic, the box) and NotFound (a list not offered).

getSubscriptionRequest: the public request a confirmation link's token names (read only: a mail scanner's fetch changes nothing): the organization, the address masked, the topics with their consent wording, its state (pending, confirmed, closed) and expiry. A wrong, expired or another site's token answers NotFound; each lookup counts against the requester's limit.

verifySubscription (a POST, a bearer write): the request's topics accepted for its address (the person's own confirmation, source the email link), each still offered, under the request's lock; once: a replay answers the first result, and a withdrawal after the request is never undone by it. Answers the request's view and a receipt.

getMarketingForm: a Marketing publication answered on this site, by its id (anyone with the page, or signed-in accounts) or by an invitation link's token (scope MarketingSurvey): open, of the organization the site's marketing mount serves; its heading, introduction, organization and the questions with their rules as of now (the customer-visible fields; never an internal field, a score or a draft), the subscription choice its list offers on the site, and the receipt in place of the questions once an invitation (or an account under the once policy) has answered. A site without the mount, an unpublished, closed or another site's publication and a forged, expired or another site's token answer the same NotFound; each token lookup counts against the requester's limit.

submitMarketingForm (a POST; anonymous for a public publication, a bearer write with an invitation's token): publicationId or token, values (a map, or its JSON text), operationId (PASS's request key), subscribe and subscriptionEmail (the separate subscription choice). The answer is kept through mantle.party.FormPublicationServices.accept#Submission's rule (the form as of now, each value of its type, the request key's one submission, an invitation answered once); then the subscription choice files a public request of the publication's list with its own verification message (Subscribe's path and address limit), apart, recorded on the submission. Answers the publication's neutral receipt, also for a submission past the client's (30 in ten minutes) or site's (1,000 an hour) limit, an oversized one, one naming a field the page never offered, and a repeat (nothing kept); Unprocessable with what to fix for a value the visitor can fix (an answer to a question its rules hide among them); NotFound as getMarketingForm.

getMarketingPage: a landing page of the site's marketing mount at a route (routePath, locale), as a visitor reads it: the site page services' get#SitePage (the binding's exact published wiki version in its window, its markdown as clean HTML), its title and SEO, and its parts in order, clean HTML between the embedded components its text names ("[[subscribe ID]]" or "[[form ID]]" on a line of its own, at most five), which the page renders through getMarketingPublication and getMarketingForm, so only a list offered or a form open on this site shows. A site without the mount and a draft, scheduled, withdrawn or unknown page answer the same NotFound. Read only.

getMarketingEvent: a published registration offer (registrationPolicyId) of the organization the site's marketing mount serves, on that site, for an occurrence still to come of an event not cancelled (mantle.work EventRegistrations.js publicView): its title and description, the occurrence's dates in the offer's zone, where (or that it is online, never the call link), each ticket's price from its product (or free) and advisory availability, whether registration is open, and the terms. A site without the mount, a draft, closed, past or another site's or organization's offer and an unknown id answer the same NotFound. No attendee, room, budget or campaign is in the answer. Read only.

The Marketing app's readiness checks for a site (PublicApps.js): its target an internal organization, a list offered there or a form publication open there (P12) or a landing page published there (P14) or an event's registration offer published there (P16), a ready transactional sending profile of the organization (a promotional one never sends a verification), a published confirmation template on each offered list, and the site's canonical host.

Internal (P7 review): one attempt of a verification delivery (source MdsrcSubscriptionVerify, any other is left alone), registered by request#Subscription to run on a service worker once the request commits, so the request's answer never waits on the mail; a later attempt is the ledger's run#Deliveries.

Internal, for Shop's checkout opt-in (StoreTopics.js, impl-shop §7, F26): the buyer's store-news choice filed on the store's news list through the audience's evidenced path, source PcsCheckout, pending (the receipt's link confirms it) or, with accept, accepted (a verified account, or the receipt's link); the caller decides who may.
